attributes.text: Some questions are answered at https://timelimit.io/en/ and it is a good idea to take a look at https://timelimit.io/en/configsuggestions/ because the default configuration is most likely not what you need. This links are shown in the about screen, so there is no need to write them down. If all that does not help you, then you can still ask the support. Every proper support request results in a proper reply within a short time. Public reviews are not intended for asking questions; you should not expect an answer there. You should ask yourself if you want help or just complain before writing a bad review.
